reading.title: PAYMENTS IN LIEU OF TAXES AGREEMENT

candidates.quote: Project: The new construction of 112 units of affordable multifamily rental housing for seniors.
candidates.wording: 112 units

candidates.quote: Eligible Households: Households earning 70% of less of AMI
candidates.wording: Households earning 70% of less of AMI

candidates.quote: Number of Affordable Units: 112
candidates.wording: Number of Affordable Units: 112

candidates.quote: Number of Market Rate Units: 0
candidates.wording: Number of Market Rate Units: 0

candidates.quote: $47,600 per year or $425 per Affordable Unit per year.
candidates.wording: $47,600 per year or $425 per Affordable Unit per year
candidates.value: $47,600 per year or $425 per Affordable Unit per year

candidates.quote: Term (in years): 40 years
candidates.wording: 40 years

candidates.quote: A. The Owner has or will acquire the Property located in Prince George’s County, Maryland for the purpose of constructing or rehabilitating the Project to provide housing to Eligible Households.
candidates.wording: The Owner
candidates.value: New Carrollton Affordable Senior I, LLC

candidates.quote: B. The Owner has or will contract to construct or rehabilitate the Project to provide housing to Eligible Households as set forth in the Owner’s Application for a PILOT.
candidates.wording: Eligible Households

candidates.quote: D. The Owner submitted a request or application to the County to permit the Owner to make payments in lieu of County real property taxes pursuant to Section 7 -506.3 of the Tax-Property Article of the Annotated Code of Maryland (the “ Act”).
candidates.wording: payments in lieu of County real property taxes

candidates.quote: (3) the owner of the real property agrees to (A) continue to commence or continue to maintain the real property as rental housing for lower income persons under the requirements of the governmental programs described in item (2) of this paragraph and agrees to renew any annual contributions contract or other agreement for rental subsidy or supplement or (B) enters into an agreement with the governing body of the county to allow the entire property or the portion of the property which was maintained for lower income persons to remain as housing for lower income persons for a term of at least five years; and
candidates.wording: the owner of the real property agrees

candidates.quote: (4) the owner and the governing body of the county where the real property is located agree that the owner shall pay a negotiated amount in lieu of the applicable county property taxes.
candidates.wording: pay a negotiated amount in lieu of the applicable county property taxes
candidates.value: negotiated amount in lieu of taxes

candidates.quote: F. Pursuant to the County Resolution, the County Council of Prince George’s County, Maryland, approved the County entering into an agreement PILOT for the Property and authorized the County to enter into this agreement for negotiated payments in lieu of the payment of Prince George’s County taxes for the Project.
candidates.wording: approved the County entering into an agreement PILOT

candidates.quote: “Affordability Covenants” means the covenants executed and recorded on the Property, in a form acceptable to the County, that require the Owner and all subsequent owners of the Property to offer for rent at least the Affordable Units to Eligible Households.
candidates.wording: offer for rent at least the Affordable Units

candidates.quote: “Affordability Covenants” means the covenants executed and recorded on the Property, in a form acceptable to the County, that require the Owner and all subsequent owners of the Property to offer for rent at least the Affordable Units to Eligible Households.
candidates.wording: Owner and all subsequent owners

candidates.quote: “Affordable Units” mean those rental units in the Project that will be dedicated to the Eligible Households.
candidates.wording: rental units in the Project that will be dedicated to the Eligible Households

candidates.quote: “Affordable Unit Annual Payment ” means the amount set forth in the Project Facts Section that represents the amount the Owner shall pay in lieu of taxes in accordance with this Agreement for the Affordable Units.
candidates.wording: amount the Owner shall pay in lieu of taxes

candidates.quote: “Annual Payment” means the amount or formula set forth in the Project Facts Section that represents the amount that the Owner shall pay in lieu of taxes in accordance with this Agreement for a tax year .
candidates.wording: amount that the Owner shall pay in lieu of taxes

candidates.quote: “Eligible Households” mean the households as described in the Project Facts Section that are eligible to reside in the Project and whose initial annual income is sixty percent (60%) or less of the median income as set from time to time by the United States Department of Housing and Urban Development for Section 8 Programs in the Baltimore Metropolitan Statistical Area.
candidates.wording: initial annual income is sixty percent (60%) or less of the median income

candidates.quote: If the Project consist entirely of Affordable Units, then the Annual Payment shall consist of the Affordable Unit Annual Payment.
candidates.wording: If the Project consist entirely of Affordable Units

candidates.quote: If the Project consist of both Affordable Units and Market Rate Units, the Annual Payment shall consist of the Affordable Unit Annual Payment plus the Market Rate Unit Annual Payment.
candidates.wording: If the Project consist of both Affordable Units and Market Rate Units
candidates.value: Affordable Units and Market Rate Units

candidates.quote: “Term” means that period of time equal to the number of full tax years set forth in the Project Facts Section which commences on the Substantial Completion Date and expiring on the last day of such period.
candidates.wording: Term means that period of time equal to the number of full tax years set forth in the Project Facts Section
candidates.value: Number of full tax years set forth in the Project Facts Section

candidates.quote: This Agreement shall become effective as of the Effective Date and the obligation to pay negotiated payments in lieu of taxes for the Project shall commence as of the Substantial Completion Date and shall remain effective until the Termination Date.
candidates.wording: shall remain effective until the Termination Date

candidates.quote: “Owner” means the Owner identified in the Project Facts Section who is also the signatory of and party to this Agreement.
candidates.wording: Owner means the Owner identified in the Project Facts Section
candidates.value: Owner identified in the Project Facts Section

candidates.quote: Owner shall submit to the County’s Director of Finance and the County’s Director of the Department of Housing and Community Development, within five (5) business days after execution by Owner, the following documents: entity agreements, including but not limited to, the Operating Agreement or Limited Partnership Agreement, the Affordability Covenants, and any other agreement or documents deemed necessary for submission to the County.
candidates.wording: Owner shall submit to the County’s Director of Finance and the County’s Director of the Department of Housing and Community Development

candidates.quote: If requested by the County, the Owner shall provide a copy of the Certificate of Substantial Completion to the County’s Director of Finance and the Director of the Department of Housing and Community Development within five (5) business days after issuance.
candidates.wording: the Owner shall provide a copy of the Certificate of Substantial Completion

candidates.quote: If the Owner has not paid the amount due under this Agreement before March 30th following the due date, the County may, at its option, declare a default by providing notice of such default to the Owner and to the Persons listed on Exhibit B attached hereto.
candidates.wording: the County may, at its option, declare a default
candidates.value: Default declared if unpaid before March 30th

candidates.quote: “PILOT” means the negotiated payments in lieu of taxes.
candidates.wording: PILOT means the negotiated payments in lieu of taxes

candidates.quote: Owner agrees to maintain the Property as rental housing for lower income persons under the requirements a federal, State, or local government program and the Owner agrees to renew any annual contributions contract or other agreement for rental subsidy or supplement.
candidates.wording: rental housing for lower income persons
